spinner: A ten-fold girih star in gold with a vermilion heart, turning a tenth of a turn at a time, the step its own symmetry.
skeleton: Lines ruled in gold for a scribe, ragged on the left, each written in from the right as the pen of this script moves.
switch: An eight-fold star in a ruled slot; on, the slot is gilded and the lapis star turns as it slides across.
check: Ruled cells: the tick is burnished in on a gold plate, and the radio's mark is the vermilion rubric dot a scribe sets in a gold ring.
toast: An illuminated panel with a four-ring ruled frame and a gold rosette with a vermilion heart, burnished open left to right.
dialog: A manuscript page headed by its shamsa, a ten-fold gold medallion that turns into place while the ruled page is burnished open.
tooltip: A gold cartouche with the pointed ends of a toranj and a ruling inside its edge, burnished open.
steps: Verse markers: gold-ruled rosettes numbered in the Persian digits, joined by gold rules with a dot, the current one a vermilion plate ringed in gold.
empty: An unwritten page in a four-ring frame under an empty outlined girih medallion and a gold display title.
link: A gold hairline at rest; under the pointer it becomes a row of vermilion dots, the nuqta of the script.
